mapper.select: SELECT ast02_detail_id AS detail_id, ast02_seq AS seq, ast02_title AS title, ast02_tag AS tag, COALESCE(ast02_use_yn, 'true') AS use_yn FROM ast02_detail WHERE ast02_default_yn = #{defaultYn} AND ast02_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast02_company_id = 0 AND ast02_ast_class_tree_id = 0 AND upper(coalesce(ast02_title,'')||coalesce(ast02_tag,'')) LIKE upper(#{searchText}) AND ( ( #{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(ast02_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) OR ( #{useYn} = 'false' ) ) ORDER BY ast02_seq
SELECT ast02_detail_id AS detail_id, ast02_seq AS seq, ast02_title AS title, ast02_tag AS tag, ast02_use_yn AS use_yn FROM ast02_detail WHERE ast02_detail_id = #{detailId}
